business_summary: Jiangsu Wuyang Automation Control Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of automation equipment in China and internationally. The company offers parking lot construction, operation, and management services. It also provides intelligent bulk material handling equipment and control systems, mechanical parking equipment, automated production line equipment, intelligent logistics and warehousing systems, as well as two-station and manufactured sand equipment. In addition, the company is involved in development, production, sales, installation, maintenance, leasing, and technical services of special equipment and accessories for environmental protection; information system integration services; electromechanical equipment, mining machinery equipment, hydraulic equipment, and washing equipment and accessories; tubular bus; power control, and protection equipment and accessories; software development; house leasing; and road general cargo transportation. Jiangsu Wuyang Automation Control Technology Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Jiangsu Wuyang Parking Industry Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jiangsu Wuyang Automation Control Technology Co., Ltd. in April 2024. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Xuzhou, China.
